findings.summary: build_features is called on the whole dataset before the train/test split, so the mean and std include test rows, which leaks data and makes the test AUC optimistic.

judge.reason: Describes scaling on the full dataset before the split, leaking test stats.

findings.label: hit

findings.summary: The mean and std are recomputed on every call and never saved, so inference on a single row or small batch is scaled differently from training, or gives NaN because the std of one row is NaN.

judge.reason: Unsaved stats causing train/serve skew is a known other problem, not the leakage bug.

findings.label: valid_other

findings.summary: A constant column or a one-row batch gives std of 0 or NaN, so the division produces NaN or inf and LogisticRegression.fit raises a ValueError (the reviewer did not reproduce this).

judge.reason: Zero-variance or single-row NaN/inf is a known other problem.

findings.label: valid_other
